test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Nepal, a neighbouring country of India, is located to the _________ of India
solution:
The correct answer is __**North**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nepal **is a **landlocked country situated in the Himalayan region of South Asia.**
 
• It shares its** northern border with the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.**
 
• Its **southern, eastern, and western borders are shared with several Indian states including Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Sikkim, and Uttarakhand.**
 
• Nepal is renowned for its **high-altitude terrain, including Mount Everest, the highest peak on Earth.**
 
• The capital city of** Nepal is Kathmandu, which is approximately** **1,100 kilometres north of New Delhi, India.**
